records.text:
Hello Nate23__,
Sorry you're experiencing this issue with your monitor.
Does the dimming occur with every game and content type on the PS5, or have you only noticed it with specific games after longer play sessions?
Since you've already performed factory resets, disabled HDR, Dolby Vision, OLED care options, and recalibrated HDR, try the following:
Test the monitor with another device such as a PC, laptop, or different console for an extended period to see whether the same dimming behavior occurs.
If available, switch to a different video input on the monitor and retest.
Try a different HDMI cable to rule out a signal-related issue.
For testing purposes, temporarily disable VRR and 120 Hz output on the PS5 and check whether the behavior changes at 60 Hz.
Leave the monitor at its default picture settings during testing and avoid enabling additional image enhancement features.
Observe whether the dimming appears across multiple games or only under specific conditions.
If the monitor behaves normally with other devices, that would help narrow the focus to the video signal configuration being used with the PS5. If the dimming also occurs with different devices, inputs, and cables, please let us know the results of those tests so we can continue troubleshooting with you.
Best regards,

records.author: @江南春观世界
records.text:
你说的没错，QD-OLED 和 Tandem（双层）WOLED 确实极大地解决了亮度和寿命问题，在手机和显示器上，OLED 绝对是目前的王者。但在电视这种动辄 75 寸、85 寸甚至 98 寸的巨幕市场，OLED 有一个绕不开的死穴——蒸镀工艺的有机材料极其昂贵，尺寸越大，良率越低，成本呈指数级飙升。
反观中国厂商主导的 Mini LED，本质上是沿用极其成熟的 LCD 产线，通过增加 LED 灯珠数量来提升画质。这等于用极低的边际成本，打出了接近 OLED 的效果。
所以，OLED 在“中小尺寸高端市场”是最优解；而 Mini LED 则是“超大尺寸大众市场”的版本答案。这不仅是利润的博弈，更是两条供应链的生死战。欢迎订阅频道，之后我会做更多不同面向的影片！

records.author: @江南春观世界
records.text:
你说到最核心的痛点了！淘宝上 85 寸 TCL Mini LED 卖五千多，这个价格杀伤力太恐怖了。
索尼为什么“玩不下去”？因为电视市场的消费逻辑变了。大众消费者最直观的感受是“大就是爽”，而 OLED 有一个致命的物理限制：尺寸越大，成本呈指数级上升。大尺寸 OLED 面板产能几乎被 LG 和三星捏在手里，85 寸的 OLED 电视动辄两三万甚至更高，根本没法打。
反观中国品牌，靠着极其成熟的 LCD 面板产业链，加上 Mini LED 背光技术，硬生生把 85 寸、98 寸这种巨幕做成了平民价。当 85 寸 Mini LED 只要五千多的时候，绝大多数普通家庭根本不会去管什么是“纯黑位”、什么是“像素自发光”，大屏幕带来的视觉冲击力直接碾压了一切。
索尼的高溢价在这种“规模+供应链”的降维打击下，确实很难受。欢迎你订阅频道，之后我会做更多不同面向的影片！

records.text: @ZakariyaElBaghdadi Yes. And miniled is better than OLEDs actually, so never buy an OLED panel. What people don't mention is that OLEDs are unable to maintain display brightness. They are stuck to 220 nits paper white and midtones. records.author: @DylanNelUSA
records.text:
PRODUCT DETAILS
- Laptop Model: 
Lenovo - Legion 7i 16" 2.5k OLED Gaming Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 255HX 2025 - 32GB RAM - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 - 1TB SSD - Glacier White
- Processor: Intel Core Ultra 7 255HX 2025


THE TECHNICAL DEFECT
I have had about 5 different laptops (HP Victus, being the best so far, but many other monster laptops too, and a few not so well spec’d laptops too) in the last 7 years 

Many issues with the Legion:
1.	This PC was stuck in dark mode. 6 hours of research, I finally found something called Burn Prevention which is found in Lenovo Vantage, and then hidden away. What this stupid setting does is override Windows setting and enforces dark mode.
2.	PC kept changing Outlook, Word, Excel settings back to default
3.	My Victus, I could connect a 4-in-1 4K USB C to Dual HDMI Adapter Hub 60Hz, Includes USB 3.0 & PD Port to the C Type Port, 2 screens + headphones connected to the Adaptor, then a fourth screen connected to HDMI (that would be PC screen (1), 2 through the adaptor and then a fourth through the HDMI. 
4.	This poor Legion will not allow a set up for 2 extra screens through the adaptor. Originally when purchased, it worked this way. But now, if I do somehow get this set up working, it will work for an hour or 2, but as soon as I open a PDF (for example), the system reverts back to 1 pc screen, and the 2 extra screens are now showing the same display. I then push W+K, go to settings, and screen 3 is not available there. Again, about 6 or 7 hours of reading done on this. I have not found a resolution.
5.	Today, all of a sudden, this laptop will not connect to my printer. All of my other laptops connect, not this one. I was previously connected, but now there are some how 2 drivers for the printer on this laptop, no clue how the second got there, and the printer will not connect, to this laptop only. It just loads the queue.

These are just a few of the issues, but If I can advise anyone wanting to purchase this laptop, I would say stay clear.

6.	Fans are always blasting away.
7.	Temp is always extremely high just below the screen (top of keyboard)
8.	Super slow at start up
9.	Take a second to realise what I am requesting, for example, open excel, it could take about 3 seconds to get the process started. The little men inside are too busy…. Doing nothing, I need to wake them up first.

These technical defects render a brand-new $1,700 premium laptop completely unusable for its intended purpose.
